technology_type.evidence: inferred: In-Solution  The urine pellet was dissolved in 100uL 8M urea/200mM Tris-HCL pH 8.5. The dissolved samples were reduced with 5mM DTT for 30min and alkylated with 20mM IAA in dark for 30min. The 100uL urine in 8M urea/200mM Tris-HCl were diluted with 400 uL water before tryspin/LysC digestion (enzyme: protein ratio is 1:50) for overnight at 27°C.
